Let \(\varepsilon=\frac1{625}\). Then

\[
\sqrt[4]{625+1}-\sqrt[4]{625-1}
=5\left((1+\varepsilon)^{1/4}-(1-\varepsilon)^{1/4}\right).
\]

Using the binomial expansion,

\[
(1+\varepsilon)^{1/4}-(1-\varepsilon)^{1/4}
=2\left(\frac14\varepsilon+\frac{7}{128}\varepsilon^3+\cdots\right)
=\frac12\varepsilon+O(\varepsilon^3).
\]

Thus

\[
\sqrt[4]{626}-\sqrt[4]{624}
=5\left(\frac12\cdot\frac1{625}+O(\varepsilon^3)\right)
=\frac1{250}+O(\varepsilon^3).
\]

So the reciprocal is very close to \(250\), specifically slightly less than \(250\). Therefore the closest integer is

\[
\boxed{250}
\]
